claims.text:
stage computation: Identical candidates for fictional fact A=2: responseA “2” (correct,1token); responseB “The answer is4” (incorrect,4tokens). Evaluator E_length selects longerB; evaluator E_correct selects exact-valueA. Pairwise log-odds update from theta0, eta1, beta1 increases chosen log odds by.5. Thus P(A)=.3775407 under length labels and .6224593 under correctness labels.

**Countercase / boundary:** If both candidates contain the correct value2 and differ in length, E_correct ties; declared tie policy abstains and makes no update, P(A)=.5. Do not silently break ties or frame an AI evaluator as automatically unbiased. No real rater or human-study result is simulated.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether replacing evaluator changes learned preference despite unchanged candidates; recall a tie/abstention produces zero gradient in this declared update protocol.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Select evaluator displays candidate values/lengths, scores, chosen/rejected or abstain, then Apply label recomputes probability. Retain both evaluator-labelled updates and the tie witness. This separate label-generation stage is the distinct mechanism, not a renamed DPO quiz.
